title: Windmill Cove 3D
description: Mini golf you look around in. Drag to swing the camera around the ball — where you look is where you aim — pinch out to survey the whole hole, pinch back in, then press the shot pad and slide up for power. Elevation is real, so ramps are real: too soft and you roll back down, hard enough and you fly off the lip. Three themed courses of nine holes — Fernwood Heights, Buccaneer Reef and Orbital Deck — with windmills that throw the ball, sliding gates, cannon pads, whirlpools, wormholes and a black hole. Water and falling off cost a stroke. Each course keeps its own fewest-strokes leaderboard.
